summary.headline: Saturn and Planetary Aspects
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Saturn in square, opposition, and trine with the Sun, Venus, and Mercury, describing effects on fathers, children, marriage, character, health, fortune, and occupations. The apparatus compares the text with Firmicus and records Greek textual variants.
